text:
Type: narrow pine five-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes, socks and small items; bedroom, hallway, small spaces
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, farmhouse
Materials: solid untreated knotty pine, round wooden knobs
Colors: pale natural pine, warm honey knots
Shape: tall slender chest with a shallow top drawer over four deeper ones, one round knob centered on each, slightly overhanging top, straight square legs, slim footprint, light visual weight
Feel: natural, warm, simple, honest
Goes with: white walls, linen bedding, wool throws, black accents; Scandinavian, rustic or farmhouse bedrooms
